motivation: The label-free stage probe measured Viterbi as the largest sampled search stage. The current eight-lane kernel computes floor(i*T/L) with integer division in each lane on every profile row. Test an exact quotient/remainder recurrence, not a score or sensitivity heuristic.
hypothesis: Hoisting T/L and T%L once per lane and incrementing the band center by quotient plus remainder carry can reduce scalar division overhead without changing any visited DP cell or integer score.

mechanism.identity: For row i, center=floor(i*T/L). With q=T/L and r=T%L, initialize center=0 and residual=0, then add q and r per row and add one to center when residual>=L. Subtract L on carry. This is exactly the same nonnegative integer division.
mechanism.residual_type: int64_t to avoid overflow when L approaches the int32 limit
mechanism.zero_lengths: Preserve existing early returns and dummy/empty lane behavior
mechanism.default: Existing division path and public ABI remain the default; recurrence gets a separate exported entry point and explicit Python opt-in.

validation: Compile only isolated test/frozen-checkout libraries; do not overwrite libraries used by live experiments.
Compare recurrence against original division, scalar C and Numba on boundary sizes, empty/unknown-residue targets, tail batches, reordered pairs, multiple bands and thread counts.
Reject invalid mode names and missing recurrence exports rather than silently selecting another algorithm.
Preserve inputs and caller pair order byte-for-byte; test default behavior and ABI compatibility.

benchmark.design: Fixed label-free native/synthetic kernel batches; identical arrays and compiler flags for both paths. Warm both modes, interleave paired repeats and retain failures. No benchmark reference labels or threshold fitting.
benchmark.selection: Advance only with exact integer-score equality and repeatable directional cost reduction on multiple batch shapes. Otherwise retain the unsuccessful opt-in experiment without default promotion.
benchmark.scope: Kernel cost only; no isolated full-pipeline speed claim or imputed eight-endpoint accuracy vector. Any pipeline adoption needs broader output-preserving validation.

live_jobs: Do not modify, stop, restart or repin the fresh-HMM cap or component-phylogeny jobs.
